text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe lets out a quiet sigh. She looks a little dejected…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I ordered some special coffee, but I just found out the delivery is going to be massively delayed…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe remains dispirited for the rest of the day. The delay must have come as quite the shock…
